title: Nourishing Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and earthy Jamaican dish featuring a mixture of curry powder and bhuna, made paleo-friendly and cooked to perfection in a fondue pot, this kid-friendly recipe is sure to delight both children and adults alike.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the curry powder, bhuna powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
